page: OVHcloud b3-64 is a General Purpose cloud server powered by an AMD EPYC processor utilizing the x86_64 architecture. It features 16 dedicated physical cores running at 2.3 GHz with a single thread per core, providing a highly predictable compute environment. The hardware configuration includes 64.0 GB of system memory, yielding a balanced 4.0 GB of RAM per core. Storage is provided via a local 400 GB NVMe SSD, and network connectivity is supported by a 4 Gbps baseline bandwidth.

Benchmark evaluations indicate strong performance in memory-intensive operations and single-core tasks. The server achieves top-tier results in stress-ng single-core CPU performance and large-block memory bandwidth tests, both read and write. Multi-threaded bzip3 decompression and PassMark memory scores also rank in the top 25%. Conversely, multi-core CPU performance, database operations, and Redis SET throughput align with mid-range averages.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the b3-64 offers a balanced resource density, pairing dedicated AMD EPYC cores with fast NVMe storage without the premium of specialized memory or GPU hardware. This makes it a highly capable platform for general-purpose workloads. It is well-suited for hosting web servers, running medium-scale database operations, executing multi-threaded data decompression tasks, and handling moderate LLM inference workloads using smaller models.
